issues.description: In the template's commented example, Main.java invokes a Farm method named feed(), but the problem statement and the reference solution define and use feedAllAnimals(). Specifically: the template example calls farm.feed() (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java line 20), while the specification describes feedAllAnimals() (problem_statement.md lines 107-111) and the solution's Main and Farm classes use feedAllAnimals() (solution Main.java line 20; solution Farm.java defines feedAllAnimals() at lines 27-31). This naming mismatch can confuse students who uncomment or copy the example and expect a feed() method to exist, or who search the spec/solution for the sample call and find a different name.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template consistent with the problem statement and solution. Update the commented example in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java to call farm.feedAllAnimals() instead of farm.feed(), or alternatively add a small convenience method feed() to the Farm class in the template that delegates to feedAllAnimals() (e.g., public void feed() { feedAllAnimals(); }) so the example remains valid without changing student-facing instructions.
